issue.title: Bug: application crashes when exporting CSV
issue.body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Open a project.
2. Select Export CSV.

Expected behavior: a CSV file is downloaded.
Actual behavior: the application crashes.
Environment: Windows 11, Python 3.12.

Traceback: RuntimeError: export failed.
issue.author: sample-user

rationale: Potentially release-blocking or major workflow impact language detected.
